mapper.insert: MERGE INTO T_RECRUITMENT TARGET USING ( SELECT #{saraminJobId} AS SARAMIN_JOB_ID, #{companyName} AS COMPANY_NAME, #{title} AS TITLE, #{jobUrl} AS JOB_URL, #{locationName, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS LOCATION_NAME, #{jobName, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JOB_NAME, #{experienceLevel, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS EXPERIENCE_LEVEL, #{expirationDate, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AS EXPIRATION_DATE, #{closeType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS CLOSE_TYPE, NVL(#{isActive, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 1) AS IS_ACTIVE FROM DUAL ) SOURCE ON (TARGET.SARAMIN_JOB_ID = SOURCE.SARAMIN_JOB_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET TARGET.COMPANY_NAME = SOURCE.COMPANY_NAME, TARGET.TITLE = SOURCE.TITLE, TARGET.JOB_URL = SOURCE.JOB_URL, TARGET.LOCATION_NAME = SOURCE.LOCATION_NAME, TARGET.JOB_NAME = SOURCE.JOB_NAME, TARGET.EXPERIENCE_LEVEL = SOURCE.EXPERIENCE_LEVEL, TARGET.EXPIRATION_DATE = SOURCE.EXPIRATION_DATE, TARGET.CLOSE_TYPE = SOURCE.CLOSE_TYPE, TARGET.IS_ACTIVE = SOURCE.IS_ACTIVE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( RECRUITMENT_NUM, SARAMIN_JOB_ID, COMPANY_NAME, TITLE, JOB_URL, LOCATION_NAME, JOB_NAME, EXPERIENCE_LEVEL, EXPIRATION_DATE, CLOSE_TYPE, IS_ACTIVE, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_T_RECRUITMENT.NEXTVAL, SOURCE.SARAMIN_JOB_ID, SOURCE.COMPANY_NAME, SOURCE.TITLE, SOURCE.JOB_URL, SOURCE.LOCATION_NAME, SOURCE.JOB_NAME, SOURCE.EXPERIENCE_LEVEL, SOURCE.EXPIRATION_DATE, SOURCE.CLOSE_TYPE, SOURCE.IS_ACTIVE, SYSDATE )
